findings.description: Critical: `LocalEndpointService.sync_from_agents_config` does `getattr(agent, "model", None)`, but `AgentEntry` has no `model` field and the agents schema only added `endpoint_kind`/`base_url`. Endpoint-only agents therefore always catalog under `agent.name` (locked in by `test_agents_registry_local_endpoint_is_registered_for_probing`), so `POST /routing/select_model` can return a non-serving model id. Health probes hit `{base_url}/models` but never replace the catalog model from the probe payload, and review discovery resolves a different model via archetype/CLI/SDK fallbacks.
findings.resolution: Add an optional top-level `model` (or equivalent) to the agents schema/`AgentEntry`, require it for `endpoint_kind in {local,openrouter}`, thread it through `sync_from_agents_config`, and/or update catalog rows from a successful `/models` probe. Align review-dispatcher and catalog model identity.

findings.description: Critical: `RoutingService.select_model` always calls `choose(..., budget=ExplorationBudget())` with default `pct_used=0` / `usd_used=0` and persists `budget_state: {}`. The dual-ceiling gate in `exploration.py` therefore never exhausts, so exploration stays epsilon-open on every request instead of stopping after the configured task-share/USD ceilings. Decision provenance cannot show real budget burn-down.
findings.resolution: Load current exploration spend/share (from the spend ledger and/or prior decisions) into `ExplorationBudget` before `choose`, and write the resulting `budget_state` into the persisted routing decision.

findings.description: Nit: `LedgerService.usage_summary` never builds `by_model` or `exploration_usd_used`, even though ledger rows already store vendor/model/endpoint_kind/exploration/actual_usd. `RoutingService.get_usage` therefore always returns `by_model: []` and `exploration_usd_used: 0.0` via `.get(..., default)`, despite OpenAPI `UsageAggregate` and the `/routing/usage` summary advertising per-model aggregates and exploration burn-down.
findings.resolution: Aggregate ledger rows into `by_model` and sum `actual_usd` where `exploration` is true into `exploration_usd_used`; add ledger tests that fail if those fields stay empty when rows exist.

findings.description: Nit: Runtime `SelectModelRequest` types `task_signals` as unconstrained `dict[str, Any]`, so `POST /routing/select_model` and the MCP tool accept missing `archetype`. OpenAPI and `contracts/generated/models.py` both require `task_signals.archetype`. Empty signals degrade to task type `unknown/medium-complexity` instead of 422.
findings.resolution: Reuse the generated `TaskSignals`/`SelectModelRequest` models (or equivalent Pydantic constraints) in `model_routing.api` so missing `archetype` returns 422 as the contract promises.

findings.resolution: Document 503 (preferably as `application/problem+json`, consistent with the decision 404 path) on `POST /routing/select_model` and refresh generated models/tests.

findings.description: Nit: `CatalogService.upsert` updates an existing row with the full `CatalogEntry.to_row()` payload, and `DirectPostgresClient.update` writes Python `None` as SQL NULL. `OpenRouterRefresher` therefore nulls `p50_latency_ms`, `quota_headroom_pct`, `quota_reset_at`, and `quota_source` on every successful refresh and forces `available=True`, wiping non-pricing fields that refresh does not own.
findings.resolution: Make refresh a partial patch (pricing/context/refreshed_at/stale only), or change `upsert` to omit nulls / merge over the existing row so unrelated columns survive.

findings.description: Optional: `usage_summary` filters `routing_spend_ledger` with `occurred_at` range predicates, but migration `040_model_routing.sql` only indexes `date_trunc('month', occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')` plus `endpoint_kind`. That expression index does not support the actual gte/lte access path used by usage/rollup.
findings.resolution: Add a btree index on `routing_spend_ledger(occurred_at)` (and keep/drop the month expression index based on real query plans).
